comments.mergedPostDetails:
Description

Avatar menu sorting is missing, we believe this is a bug as the Wing and World menu sorting is present and functioning.

-----

Steps to Reproduce

1. Launch VRChat and open the menu.

2. Open the avatar menu and select MyAvatars.

3. The sorting that existed in the previous version is gone, and the order of avatars is fixed to the order of uploads.

-----

Actual Result

*Avatar Sorting :Does not work in menus.(works fine in Wing)

*World Sorting  :No problem.

-----

Expected Result

Can be sorted correctly in the avatar menu.

-----

Workaround

Use sorting from Wing.

comments.value: Is it true that in the open beta we can’t filter our own avatars by name, upload time, or other criteria? That would be a disaster if it stays the same in the live version. Also, please don’t make the avatar market the default first tab—or at least give us an option to change the tab order. It’s really annoying having to switch back to uploaded avatars every time. I get that the avatar market is there to generate revenue, but I’ve been a VRC Plus subscriber for two years without relying on it. Uploaded avatars are a core feature of the game, so please don’t downgrade the user experience.

As has already been said, we should avoid coming to the live version with the filtering functionality missing in the open beta.

If we come to the live version, the avatar selection screen will “regress” to before the UI 2.0 update.

details:
# Issue:

With the AVM Update to the Avatars Tab in the Main Menu all the previous options were moved to "My Avatars".

My Avatars is missing quite a lot of features compared to live:

- No more "compact view"

- You can no longer sort the different categories (e.g. Date Added, Last Updated, Name, Recently Used, Performance)

- Minimizing the navigation panel removes the categories all together instead of making them icons

In general the new Avatars UI feels very weird and not coherent with the rest of the Menu.

# Expected Behaviour / Suggestion:

These missing features should be reimplemented to prevent this being a regression compared to live.

"My Avatars" should have imo just looked like it currently does on live with a "Purchased" category edited to it. Currently it just looks really out of place.
